title: HIRES the high-resolution echelle spectrometer on the Keck 10 m telescope
what_was_studied: Optical design, detector and initial performance
numerical_result: The instrument established high-resolution visible spectroscopy on Keck I; later detectors and iodine reductions define different eras
remaining_question: An original instrument description cannot represent three decades of configurations

title: Attaining Doppler precision of 3 m/s
what_was_studied: Iodine-cell forward modelling of wavelength and instrumental profile
numerical_result: The method paper demonstrated approximately 3 m/s precision in its historical configuration
remaining_question: Template, detector and line-spread modelling evolved after this result

title: Correcting the HIRES Keck radial velocity archive
what_was_studied: Systematic errors in the public HIRES velocity archive
numerical_result: Small but significant nightly zero-point systematics were identified and corrected using an ensemble
remaining_question: Ensemble corrections require leakage tests and hardware-era boundaries

title: The California Legacy Survey I
what_was_studied: Uniform planet search over decades of HIRES observations
numerical_result: The survey analysed 719 nearby stars with more than 61000 RVs from Keck HIRES and APF
remaining_question: Survey-scale planet fits do not isolate instrumental stability

title: An updated catalog of HIRES Keck radial velocity measurements
what_was_studied: Extension of public velocities and Ca II H and K measurements
numerical_result: The catalog extends public spectra through March 2023 after earlier systematic corrections
remaining_question: Reprocessed catalog versions need row-level lineage before comparison

title: NASA Keck 2027A solicitation
authors: NExScI and W. M. Keck Observatory
numerical_result: HIRES is planned to decommission no earlier than the end of 2027B; timing depends on ZShooter readiness and KPF stability
remaining_question: The final date is conditional and must not be presented as completed retirement
